title: LLMObs canonical model — common definitions (v1alpha1)
$comment: The host in $id is the product's canonical schema URL; per D15 the product name/brand lives only in packages/brand and kernel/pkg/brand, and this URL is the one permitted textual appearance. x-llmobs-frozen marks fields immutable after first write (see 05-update-semantics.md).

id.description: Stable identity string, unique within (project_id, entity).

hexId.description: Lowercase hex id (OTel trace_id/span_id rendering). Plugin/compat ids MAY be non-hex; use 'id' for those.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant, millisecond precision or finer.

attributeMap.description: Open key/value map. Holds every non-promoted attribute; raw attributes always preserved. Keys under 'llmobs.*' are kernel-owned (02-span.md §6).

type.description: Referent kind, e.g. score_config, prompt, price, or a plugin namespaced type (evals/dataset_run_item).

label.description: Optional human-readable snapshot captured at write time (07-references.md §2).

reference.description: A (type, id) soft pointer with an optional label snapshot (07-references.md). No FK; MAY dangle.

spanEvent.description: A generic (name, timestamp, attributes) record attached to a span (02-span.md §4.4). Not an entity; union-merged on update.

usageMap.description: Usage counts (non-negative integers). Well-known keys: input, output, total, cache_read, cache_write, reasoning, audio, image (06-usage-cost.md §3). Provider-reported semantics; not comparable across providers.

costMap.description: Cost amounts as decimals (adapters preserve >= 12 fractional digits). Same well-known keys as usageMap.
